player_steps: Run setup normally and choose the Shogun 2 folder
Use Steam Play; choose a perspective in the compiled how-to guide to continue launch

retained_exact_gameplay_sources_and_bina.source: Test162/build-3; gameplay initially passed in Test162/build-1

iteration_notes: The unbuilt installer-only camera choice draft was abandoned after the owner clarified the required launch flow; preserved privately.

First post-Steam failure fixture exposed premature synthetic-client restart and an unsuppressed diagnostic dialog. That fixture failed and is retained; its own registration was uninstalled and the dialog dismissed.
Final fixture moves the Steam apply into preparation, aborts the simulated failure at ssInstall, restores Steam and six targets before reopening its client, and suppresses unattended dialogs.
Production packaging is bound to the exact fixture-tested integration and Steam source hashes; synthetic and production Steam helpers intentionally differ.
limitations: Real elevated installer/original-user behavior, Steam expansion, CA launcher/DRM/overlay/fullscreen and application-specific recordings remain live acceptance steps.
The capture fixture records only its own synthetic tone process.
Uninstall still requires Steam and Shogun 2 closed.
Unknown wrappers, ambiguous account metadata, a declined normal Steam shutdown or lost original unelevated user are preserved/refused rather than force-fixed.
No new gameplay/crash/performance/POV fix claimed. Latest published private release remains immutable v0.31.
